deadline.value: December 15, 2026 for Fall 2027 (all materials via the Graduate School application)
deadline.quote: Fall 2027 Physics PhD Application Deadline: December 15, 2026

app_fee.value: Amount not shown on the pages checked; one fee covers up to 3 UW-Madison programs
app_fee.quote: You can apply to 3 different graduate programs at UW-Madison for only one application fee.

fee_waiver.value: Department gives no waivers; Graduate School fee grants are for U.S. citizens and permanent residents only
fee_waiver.quote: Fee grants are available to U.S. citizens and permanent residents who can document that they meet one of these eligibility criteria:

also.quote: The Department of Physics is not able to provide application fee waivers, but we encourage you to apply for a fee grant from the Graduate School if you qualify.

gre_general.value: General GRE is not considered even if submitted
gre_general.quote: The general GRE will not be considered even if submitted.

gre_physics.value: Not required; reviewed if sent; recommended if your transcript understates you, it would significantly help, or you aim for theory
gre_physics.quote: The Department of Physics does not require the subject GRE for admission. | The subject GRE is recommended in these circumstances: Your transcript does not accurately reflect your academic strengths If including the score would significantly strengthen your application You are particularly interested in pursuing Physics Theory as a research focus

toefl_min.value: TOEFL 92 (before Jan 21, 2026) or 5.0 (new scale); IELTS, IELTS Indicator, Duolingo also accepted
toefl_min.quote: Minimum TOEFL requirement:92 for tests taken before January 21, 2026 | Minimum TOEFL requirement:5.0 for tests taken on and after January 21, 2026

english_waiver.value: Graduate School decides via a country-selector tool; result for India not shown in static page text

supervisor.value: Advisor chosen after entry; early selection encouraged; any physics faculty or affiliate
supervisor.quote: An early start in selecting a research area and a doctoral advisor is encouraged and expected; students in the Physics PhD program may select any physics faculty member or affiliate member.

funding.value: Five years of financial support guaranteed for admitted PhD students
funding.quote: All admitted PhD students are provided with a guarantee of five years of financial support.

entry_route.value: Applicants need a bachelor's meeting Graduate School requirements
entry_route.quote: Applicants must satisfy the Graduate School requirements for undergraduate grade-point average, bachelor’s degree, and English proficiency

notes: Official GRE/TOEFL scores must come directly from ETS. Segregated fees about $800/semester for full-time students.
